title: Gorgeous 1BR Rosemary Beach Home with Beach Access
meta_description: Stay in this stunning 1BR, 1BA Rosemary Beach cottage, ideal for small groups, with a sofa bed, a remodeled kitchen, and private beach access. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded: DescriptionWith the same stunning style and gorgeous design of the main home— only on a slightly more petite scale— Deauville Carriage House is the ideal pied-å-terre for smaller groups looking for the perfect balance of easy comfort and luxurious style. With a main living area and a lofted sleeping space, there’s still plenty of room to spread out at Deauville Carriage House. This convenient hideaway can also be rented with the main house for larger groups needing more space and privacy.Located above the garage, the main living area of Deauville Carriage House is on the second level, allowing for an ideal vantage point for people watching and enjoying the refreshing sea breezes. Bright white walls and large, sunny windows create an open and inviting vibe, while comfy neutral furnishings face a large HDTV— ideal for kicking back with your favorite TV show and some snacks.A cozy breakfast nook with a bistro table for four leads into the recently remodeled kitchen, where a mosaic-tile backsplash highlights sea glass-colored cabinets. Natural light streams into this space and illuminates the premier appliances, including a smooth-top electric range, dishwasher, refrigerator, and microwave. The carriage house also boasts its own washer and dryer.Sleeping spaces at Deauville Carriage House abound, including a fold-out sofa bed in the living area and two fold-out child beds tucked underneath the stairway. If you climb the steps, you’ll find a delightful lofted sleeping area with a luxe queen-size bed and a large HDTV. Back downstairs, the full bathroom features a marble vanity and a spacious, glass-enclosed shower.Deauville Carriage House also includes a lovely private terrace overlooking the charming neighborhood below. For beach lovers, nothing compares to the convenience of throwing a beach towel over your shoulder, slipping on your flip-flops, and being at the shoreline in just a few short steps. You’ll also be close to downtown Rosemary, ideal for romantic dinners or lazy afternoons of strolling around with ice cream cones.Just so you know, guests of Deauville Carriage House (guest house above garage) do not share the courtyard area, pool or outdoor kitchen with guests of Deauville Cottage (main house).Home Highlights* 2 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes* A 2 Minute walk to the Beach* Brand new 2022 Full Remodel* Complete Clean Bedding Program* 4 Minute walk to the Coquina PoolSecond Floor (Sleeps 4)GREAT ROOM with LIVING AREA (Pull-out sofa and two fold-away *small child* beds— Sleeps 4)Outdoor TERRACE Gourmet KITCHEN and DINING AREAFull BATHROOMLAUNDRY NOOK with washer and dryerThird Floor (Sleeps 2)LOFTED BEDROOM with a queen-size bed (Sleeps 2)STR-061666TDT-061666
